È un prodotto davvero delicato sulla pelle, ideale soprattutto per chi ha pelle sensibile o tende a seccarsi facilmente. Dopo l’utilizzo lascia una sensazione di pulito ma senza quella fastidiosa sensazione di pelle che tira. La texture è piacevole e basta una piccola quantità per detergere bene sia viso che corpo, quindi dura anche nel tempo. Quello che ho apprezzato di più è l’effetto idratante: già durante la doccia si percepisce che la pelle rimane più morbida e nutrita. Nel complesso è un prodotto di qualità, perfetto per un utilizzo quotidiano e adatto a tutta la famiglia.

Ha anche un profumo molto delicato che non rimane troppo sulla pelle, cosa che per me è un punto a favore. title: Good for those with skin conditions, your average consumer might not love it
review: I wouldn’t say it’s my favourite body wash in the world (sorry, but not sorry!), but I think here you are paying a little bit for the brand name and skincare expertise. If that kind of thing is important to you AND you have sensitive skin, this could be a good buy for you. I did find it left my skin less dry than many of my budget brands, I can say that much. However, I’m not a fan of there being scent in here and in particular, the scent was not that nice for me. I didn’t dislike it, but it wasn’t my favourite either. ‘Free’ body washes like this that lack certain nasties, tend to foam less and I found that to be the case here. I used it with a shower pouf and got enough of a lather, but I think if you’re using this without one, you’ll need more gel to spread it well and it’s a bit pricey for that! Whether or not this has bang for it’s buck for you depends. If you prioritise expert skincare all over, or have a condition like eczema, this could be worth it. For me, I liked it, but I wouldn’t find room in my budget for it.

title: Cleans skin well without making it dry

title: Super strong scent, its a no from me.
review: This is my first time trying a La Roche-Posay body wash, although I have tried some of their other products in the past. I really liked that this product is soap free and paraben free so I was excited to give it a try. This is marketed for sensitive skin I guess this is due to having no soap. However I found that the scent was incredibly perfumed, very strong. I was only able to use this product once because it was so strong it caused me to have some breathing issues and I had to take rescue inhalers for my breathing issues. So unfortunately this did feel nice on my skin, the smell and over powering perfume scent makes this product a no from me.

title: Surprisingly gentle and soothing body wash
review: I have already loved the LRP Lipikar Balm AP body lotion (along with a number of their sunscreens), so I was fairly certain I would enjoy this as well. I was surprised by the clear look of the body wash though, as that usually signifies your typical surfactant-filled ultra lathering body wash. That is actually not the case here. Yes, this does of course lather a little bit, but it's super gentle and feels hydrating to the skin even though it doesn't look like it would be. I found the scent extremely mild, but I'm also used to using Lush body washes, so you can take that however you'd like to. Overall I think this is a lovely body wash for sensitive skin, and mine did come equipped with a pump which was great.

title: Expensive, but superb product

review: I have been using Dove unscented for over a decade now. I always have a hard time to find an alternative. This soap from La Roche Posay seems to do the trick, except with an added scent which is fantastic. Doesn't make my skin all dry and itchy. Only thing is the expensive price tag, which seems outlandish considering it's only liquid. I guess you pay for the name...

title: High quality body soap for sensitive skin
review: I've been really happy with this body soap from La Roche Posay. The soap is very clear, with a nice gel like consistency to it. It foams up nicely, meaning you don't need too much of it to cover your whole body. The scent is refreshing while not being overpowering. After using this my skin is left feeling replenished rather than dried out which is nice. If you're looking for a way to treat yourself with a high quality body soap, than this will work for you! If you're low maintenance though and are just looking for a non-drying body soap that maximizes value, you might want to look elsewhere.
